reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin for file-based multi-agent orchestration, with Lord planning and review, Serf bounded execution, subagent dispatch, and workspace-backed task state.

summaries.zh: 通过文件化任务状态、任务分派、执行报告和审核流程，支持 DSH 中 Lord 与 Serf 智能体的协作编排。
summaries.en: Enables DSH to coordinate Lord and Serf agents through file-backed planning, task dispatch, bounded execution, reporting, and review workflows.

capabilities: Coordinates Lord and Serf agent roles through a file-based task lifecycle
Creates, reads, updates, and reviews project state, task packages, dispatch instructions, and reports in workspace files
Dispatches bounded work to subagents and supports execution fan-out within task boundaries
Validates task and report structures against documented JSON schemas
